description: This file defines the Entity Framework Core data context class 'ConduitContext' for the Conduit application. It manages database access, entity set definitions, model configurations, and transaction handling for the domain entities.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: The Entity Framework Core DbContext class that manages database operations for the Conduit domain, including DbSets, model configuration, and transaction management.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, rolling back if an exception occurs.
